edits.to: Bundle TSTP documents for any sound frame function. `buildBundle`, `bundleDocumentOf`, `bundleDocument` and `exportBundleDocument` are the `Bundle` definitions of `BundleTrace` and `BundleDocument` with the frame as a parameter, both where the pair is prepared and where the bundle is framed again for the source rows; with framer revision 2 as the frame they are those definitions. The trace and document theorems are restated for every sound frame, with SAP against `FramerLimit.ByteBundleSatisfiable` for that frame. A printed source row holds one formula and is read back by the gated framer, so the per-file limit does not change that check. `exportBundleDocument_hashed_refuted` gives the refutation for the hashed framer at any limit, over the list framer with that limit. -/

The hashed bundle framer of the limits record: the linear lexer `tokenizeFast`, the reversed statement splitter `splitStatementFast`, and records read by the counted decoder `declarationSeenC` with a `Std.HashSet Name` of seen names (their `Hashable Name` instance) and a count of them. `frameBundleHashed_eq` proves it equal to the list framer `FramerLimit.frameBundle` with the same limit, so it is a sound frame and at 1,000 it is framer revision 2. The pattern is the role framer's `RoleFramerLimit`. -/

The bundle framer (revision 2) with the per-file formula limit as a parameter. `frameBundle limit` is `FramerV2.frameBundle` with `limit` in place of 1,000, and `frameBundle_accepted` proves the two equal at 1,000. Soundness is stated for any frame function: `FrameSound frame` says that every formula statement of a framed bundle is an accepted-decoder record, and the bundle meaning, the closure and object facts and the refutation endpoint take the frame as a parameter. With `FramerV2.frameBundle` as the frame the meaning is `FramerV2.ByteBundleSatisfiable`. The structure follows the role framer's `RoleFramerLimit` and `RoleMeaningLimit`. This module imports no extracted code. -/

Fixed audit module for the limits record on the bundle path: the acceptance and export endpoints of the hashed framer at any limit and of the native frame `limited`, at their expected types, and their equality with the earlier entries at 1,000 formulas per file. -/

Compiled version-8 checker for a sealed bundle on the limits record. `BundleFastNativeMain.lean` with the hashed framer `BundleLimit.limited` in place of the linear framer and the limits of `NativeLimits.lean`: at most `Fang.NativeLimits.declarationLimit` formulas per file, duplicate names found through a hash set, and the replay limits, the predicate and literal caps and the per-file byte limit of that record. `BundleLimit.acceptsBundleLimited_refuted` states what an acceptance proves. The binary keeps the name `fang-bundle-native-fast`; the readers and error messages are those of `BundleFastNativeMain.lean`. -/

Version-8 acceptance over a sealed bundle for any sound frame function. `bundleNumeric`, `prepareBundle` and `acceptsBundle` are the `BundleV8` definitions with the frame as a parameter, and with framer revision 2 as the frame they are those definitions. For every sound frame, acceptance refutes the bundle under `FramerLimit.ByteBundleSatisfiable` for that frame. The hashed framer at any limit is sound and equal to the list framer with that limit, so `acceptsBundleHashed_refuted` restates `acceptsBundleFast_refuted` for every limit; `limited` is the hashed framer at `Fang.NativeLimits.declarationLimit`, the frame of the native checker. -/

Signed role tasks over sealed include bundles: a role-aware record decoder, a role-aware framer whose role-free view is the axiom-only bundle framer, roles read after include expansion, and the signed bundle meanings with distinct-object separation. -/

Compiled TSTP export for a sealed bundle pair on the limits record. `BundleTstpNativeMain.lean` with the hashed framer `BundleLimit.limited` and the limits of `NativeLimits.lean`, as in the bundle checker `fang-bundle-native-fast` of `BundleLimitNativeMain.lean`: it takes the same arguments, reads them under the same limits, and prints the document of `BundleLimit.exportBundleDocument` for that frame, which rebuilds and rechecks the pair. The binary keeps the name `fang-bundle-tstp`; the readers and exit codes are those of `BundleTstpNativeMain.lean`: 0 document, 2 invalid file, 4 resource limit, 7 export error, 64 usage, 74 I/O error. -/

The signed role decoder with the declaration limit as a parameter. The role loop takes the limit, a declaration counter and a hash set of seen names over the counted decoder's `declarationSeenC`; it is proved equal to the list loop with the same limit, which at 1,000 is the accepted role loop. The byte meaning needs no limit, so the decoder facts and the signed version-8 endpoints are restated for any limit. -/

The revision-2 role framer with the per-file declaration limit as a parameter. The list framer with limit 1,000 is the revision-2 role framer. The hashed framer uses the linear lexer, the reversed statement splitter, the counted record decoder with a hash set of seen names and a declaration counter, and is proved equal to the list framer with the same limit. Soundness is stated for any frame function, so the meanings and entries in `RoleMeaningLimit` and `RoleReplayLimit` take the frame as a parameter. -/

Signed role tasks over any sound frame function, through the accepted signed replay and the version-8 `checkProblem`. The read, the tasks and the entries are the revision-2 ones with `V2.frameBundle tokenize` replaced by a frame parameter. The instance for the hashed framer with the shared declaration limit of the limits record states its meanings over the list framer `frameBundle declarationLimit V2.gated`. -/

Isolated compiled checker for signed role tasks over a sealed include bundle, with the role-aware framer over framer revision 2 and the counted declaration limit of the limits record: at most `Fang.NativeLimits.declarationLimit` formulas per file, with duplicate names found through a hash set. The framer runs the linear framer lexer, the reversed statement splitter and the counted record decoder, and `V3.limited_eq` proves it equal to the list framer the meanings are stated over. The caller seals and hashes every file; each is read once. The orchestrating command selects the task: `--goal N` for the selected conjecture with index N in expansion order, or `--inputs` for a bundle without a selected conjecture. `--goals` lists the selected conjectures with their items and reads no certificate. Bundle files come as ROOT PATH FILE triples, top-level file first, as in bundle-v8/native. The replay limits, the predicate and literal caps and the per-file byte limit are those of NativeLimits.lean; the message functions are those of the earlier signed checker main SignedBundleNativeMainFast. -/

scope: Every file in lean-v8. Modules keep the archived names and bytes of the lexer full gate (including the ExpandedArityTable relocation); the native main and Fang.BoundedInput are the fast native build captures. FofInput is renamed to ExpandedFofInput because FOFInput is a different module and case-insensitive filesystems cannot hold both; only the file path and the importers' import lines change. The TSTP exporter adds the 41 modules of the document gate fof-tstp-document-v2-20261024 that are not in the lexer gate, and DocumentNativeMain pinned by hash. Install v5: the checker is the linear decoder (gate tptp-expanded-decoder-v1-20261024, main ExpandedLinearNativeMain from its native build) and the exporter uses document revision 3. Repository-only installation: the bundle checker (gate tptp-bundle-v8-fast-v1-20261024) and the signed checker (gate tptp-role-v3-v1-20261024, with BundleReplay renamed to SignedBundleReplay in that gate) are built here too. The bundle gate is tptp-bundle-v8-tstp-v1-20261025, a superset of the fast bundle gate apart from two fast-gate controls; its BundleFastFramer moves the lexer to BundleFastLexer. The signed gate is role-v4 (tptp-role-v4-v1-20261025) with the fast checker main SignedBundleNativeMainFast; BundleReplay keeps its rename to SignedBundleReplay in that gate. The bundle gate is the exporter gate tptp-bundle-v8-exporter-v1-20261025 (independent review tptp-bundle-v8-exporter-independent-review-v1-20261025 passed), with the bundle exporter fang-bundle-tstp from its native build. The single-file checker uses the limits record (gate tptp-expanded-limits-v3-20261025, main ExpandedLimitedNativeMain); the TSTP exporter keeps the 1,000-declaration path. Comment-only edits that remove machine paths and references to local records are recorded per module as comment-rewrite adaptations. The bundle path uses the limits record: gate tptp-bundle-v8-limit-v1-20261026, mains BundleLimitNativeMain and BundleTstpLimitNativeMain; the earlier bundle mains are left out. The signed gate is role-v5 (tptp-role-v5-v1-20261026) with the limited checker main SignedBundleNativeMainLimit; BundleReplay keeps its rename to SignedBundleReplay in that gate. The conjecture TSTP exporter fang-goal-tstp (gate tptp-goal-document-v6-20261026, main GoalDocumentNativeMain) prints the document of one accepted conjecture of a single file.
